summary: The extraction is accurate. I checked every bound expression, symbol mapping and setting dimension against Theorem 3, Corollaries 7, 12, 13, 15 and 19, and Theorem 26, and found no errors. The only gaps are the two generic reduction theorems (Theorem 6 and Theorem 23), which give regret bounds in terms of the abstract constants c0, c1 and c2; whether they count as missing results is debatable.
